definitions.explanation: The built-up area of a city or town where buildings and shops are concentrated. Often used in compound forms like {市街|しがい}{地|ち} (urban district) to describe developed areas.

examples.japanese: {市街|しがい}を{見渡|みわた}す。
{市街|しがい}{地|ち}の{再開発|さいかいはつ}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Redevelopment of the urban area is progressing.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}から{市街|しがい}{地|ち}までバスで{約|やく}30{分|ぷん}かかる。
examples.english: It takes about 30 minutes by bus from the airport to the city center.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the compound {市街|しがい}{地|ち} (urban district, built-up area). On its own, {市街|しがい} is more literary. The word {市街|しがい}{戦|せん} (urban warfare, street fighting) is another common compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市街|しがい}{地|ち}: urban district, built-up area
- {市街|しがい}{戦|せん}: urban warfare, street fighting
- {市街|しがい}を{歩|ある}く: walk through the city streets
- {旧|きゅう}{市街|しがい}: old town, historic district
